object: SOURCE-VALID FORCED-SUCCESSOR STATE MULTIPLICITY / CANONICAL QUOTIENT ONLY

sealed_now: Every authorized single/equal-color force returns after one deterministic pass to the same B0/C0/C2/C3 architecture unless terminal UNSAT.
M=|V minus (S union X0)| strictly decreases, so forced depth is at most n.
Immediate raw R1/R2 forced successors are O(n^2).
motivation.remaining_gap: Polynomial depth times polynomial fanout does not imply a polynomial total forced-state DAG/tree. Distinct forcing histories may still produce exponentially many proof-distinct states.

primary_question: Across all source-valid authorized forcing histories from one frozen input state, how many pairwise proof-distinct canonical successor states can occur?

success_targets.A_POLYNOMIAL_CANONICAL_QUOTIENT: Prove that all reachable forced states factor through a canonical state signature with at most n^O_s(1) or n^O(1) realizable values, with exact future R1/R2 adequacy and reconstruction.
success_targets.B_POLYNOMIAL_MEMOIZATION_DAG: Alternatively prove directly that the number of distinct reachable canonical states is polynomial and that equality can be recognized in polynomial time.
success_targets.C_SOURCE_VALID_MULTIPLICITY_OBSTRUCTION: Construct an arbitrary-N source-valid family producing superpolynomially many pairwise future-distinguishable forced states under any declared candidate quotient.

mandatory_state_coordinates_to_inventory: fixed assignments on S union X0
seed-neighborhood source type tau=N(v) intersect S where proof provenance still uses identity
C0 message type and MIN_BAD per component
B0 survivor/source-Z provenance and coarse annotation
stored reconstruction pointers for deleted/compiled components
quotient_firewalls: Same list/color masks do not automatically imply same source proof state if future source arguments still depend on seed-neighbor identities.
Same source type count does not imply semantic equivalence.
Identity differences may be quotiented only after proving exact future R1/R2 adequacy and reconstruction.
Removing fixed vertices and keeping only palettes produces a generic mixed-list P7 instance; generic mixed-list tractability is forbidden by known hardness and is not a valid shortcut.
A finite alphabet per vertex is not a polynomial global state-count theorem.
Monotone list shrinkage alone does not bound the number of global mask assignments polynomially.
No conclusion from polynomial depth plus polynomial immediate fanout.
ordered_questions: 1. Define the smallest exact canonical state representation that preserves all future authorized force queries and reconstruction.
2. Separate semantic coordinates from source-proof-only coordinates; identify which fixed identities can be forgotten and which cannot.
3. Prove or falsify that seed identities matter only through a bounded effect profile on the remaining state.
4. Count realizable successor signatures, not the raw product space.
5. Search first for source-valid independent forcing families whose histories generate many distinct color-mask/source-type patterns.
6. Test whether P7/component/source constraints force laminar, chain, bounded-antichain, bounded-rank, or other polynomial union structure on those effect profiles.
7. If a quotient is proposed, prove exact congruence: equal quotient states must have identical future R1/R2 truth tables under every legal continuation and equivalent reconstruction.
8. If no polynomial quotient is proved, preserve the first arbitrary-N multiplicity witness and do not recurse.

candidate_positive_direction.name: FORCED_EFFECT_PROFILE_QUOTIENT
candidate_positive_direction.idea: For extension semantics, fixed vertices affect each remaining vertex only through forbidden fixed colors, but source proofs may retain seed-identity dependence. Attempt to separate a semantic 4-bit color-effect layer from a proof-provenance identity layer and prove that the latter has a polynomial canonical collapse in the current source-valid class.

candidate_negative_direction.name: INDEPENDENT_FORCING_FAMILY
candidate_negative_direction.idea: Seek source-valid P7-free families with many mutually optional forced vertices such that different forced subsets induce pairwise distinct future-relevant effect profiles. Identity-distinct histories are not enough; the states must be future-distinguishable under the declared quotient.

required_for_positive: polynomial number of reachable quotient states from one input
polynomial transition generation per quotient state
insufficient: finite B0/B1 local grammar for fixed seed size
